name: Roy Lake State Park (West Unit)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-22: Esri World_Imagery at 600 m half-width (1.3 m/px) and two 120 m half-width frames (0.27 m/px, one also enlarged 2x) over the SE shore rows and the NW bay side, every Go Outdoors SD facID=55 loop 90 (West Unit) unit point plotted; all frames rendered. SE rows facing Roy Lake: pad ends of 29E and 28E ~13 m, 22E ~20 m, 20E ~20-25 m from the water, with a continuous belt of trees and shrubs along the whole shore between them (24E/26E sit inside it). NW side 3E-9E: pads ~25 m from a shallow, weed-choked bay behind a continuous tree belt and reed fringe. The modern cabins and suites on the SW tip are not RV sites. No RV pad has open ground to the water, so not lakefront; the lake is in filtered view from the SE rows -> lakeview.
inclusion_evidence: Go Outdoors SD engine https://reservations.gooutdoorssouthdakota.com/FacilityDetails.aspx?facID=55 ('Roy Lake State Park'), sitesHashMap read 2026-11-22, active units of loop 90 (the West Unit): 49 web-bookable electric RV sites 1E-52E (no 15E or 17E; 8E is an electric tent site at $23), back-ins plus pull-thrus 42E, 44E and 46E, 'Amp Service: 20/30/50', MaxEquipLength 42-82 ft, UnitBasePrice $30; tent-only T1-T5 ($16); camping cabins C3, C10, C11 ($60); modern cabins C4-C9 and suites S12-S17; group shelter PSW; host sites V1 and V2 (the GFP map marks both as host sites). GFP campground map https://gfp.sd.gov/userdocs/roy_cg.pdf (modified 2026-03-31): WEST UNIT on the peninsula with two restroom/shower buildings, a vault toilet, water, the C-Store and suites, and the entrance booth and dump station at the park entrance off 438th Ave. GFP lodging text: 'The nearest campsites are located at West Unit campground of Roy Lake State Park.' Esri imagery 2026-11-22: gravel pads at the unit points on a branching loop reached through the day-use area from the entrance booth. Real drive-in RV campground; a 23-ft rig fits every RV site (shortest 42 ft, 51E). 2.84 km from the East Unit RV-site centroid to centroid (nearest sites 51E and 57E, 2.60 km), across the lake with its own entrance. Not in the DB before (split from 5742 Roy Lake State Park, 2026-11-22). Public (state): no price gate.
note: Roy Lake State Park's West Unit campground, on a peninsula at the park's main entrance SW of Lake City, beside the modern cabins, suites, store, swim beach and the floating bridge to the Roy Island trail. The East Unit campground, about 3 km across the lake, is a separate entry. Shore sites 20E-29E look at the lake through a fringe of trees. --Claude

sites.note: Plus tent-only sites T1-T5, electric tent site 8E and camping cabins C3, C10 and C11.

season.note: October 1 to April 30 the showers, flush toilets and water may be off; vault toilets stay open.

fees.note: GFP publishes this park's own rate: non-electric $16, electric $30 a night (the statewide $7 electrical fee is already in the electric figure). Residents and non-residents pay the same to camp; the entrance licence and the $10 non-resident reservation fee are what differ.
